Unauthorized Absence Letter

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.nowdate(), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

Name of Employee: {{ doc.employee_name }}

Employee Code: {{ doc.employee_id }}

Designation: {{ doc.designation }}

Branch: {{ doc.branch_name }}

Dear {{ doc.employee_name }},

You are working with the company as {{ doc.designation }}. It has been brought to our notice that you have been absconding from duty since {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_occurrence_date, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}.

You are therefore called upon to report on duty latest by {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.date_of_1st_letter, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} or within 3 days of receipt of this letter along with an explanation for your unauthorized and continuous absence, failing which it shall be presumed that you are no longer interested in the employment and have abandoned the same.

Accordingly, the management shall initiate necessary and appropriate action including termination of your services.

For, Sahayog Multistate Credit Co-operative Society

{% set common_stamp = frappe.db.get_single_value("Sahayog HR Setting", "common_hr_stamp") %} {% if common_stamp %} {% endif %} Authorized Signatory
name: Unauthorized Absence
